title.zh: 被子植物来源限定证据

description.en: Open the Explorer at Angiospermae to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开被子植物，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Angiospermae time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的被子植物时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

description.en: Compare Angiospermae and Monocotyledones through package-linked claims and bounded occurrence context; this side-by-side route is an evidence inspection aid.
description.zh: 通过本包关联的声明与限定出现背景比较被子植物与单子叶植物；并列页面仅用于证据检查。

limitations: The two sides retain separate source, sampling, range and uncertainty boundaries; visual differences are not tests of evolutionary causation or a package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open the rounded 135 Ma atlas boundary to inspect how crown-age estimates depend on calibration choices; this card does not represent a pollen or body-fossil occurrence.
description.zh: 打开图谱取整后的 135 Ma 边界，检查冠群年龄估计对校准选择的依赖；本卡不代表花粉或植物体化石出现记录。

limitations: This is calibration-sensitivity context, not a pollen record, body-fossil occurrence, global angiosperm FAD, or exact spatial observation.

title.zh: 早白垩世被子植物分化模型

description.en: Open the 135–130 Ma model window for the metacalibrated angiosperm time-tree: Magallón et al. estimate near-contemporaneous diversification of Magnoliidae, Monocotyledoneae and Eudicotyledoneae from a 137-fossil-calibration analysis.
description.zh: 打开 135–130 Ma 的模型窗口，检查经元校准的被子植物时间树：Magallón 等基于 137 个化石校准估计木兰类、单子叶类和真双子叶类近同时分化。

limitations: This 132.5 Ma route is the rounded midpoint of a modelled 135–130 Ma crown-lineage interval (Magallón et al., pp. 448–450; Figures 2–3; Supporting Information Table S2), not a dated angiosperm specimen or global FAD/LAD.

The time-tree is an inference from sampled living taxa and fossil calibrations; it does not identify a direct ancestor, an origin centre, ecological dominance or complete Jurassic–Cretaceous distribution.

The map frame supplies age context only. Model output, PBDB occurrences and any visible markers remain separate evidence layers and are not exact fossil-to-paleomap co-registration. / 此窗口是基于现生取样类群与化石校准的模型推断，不指定直系祖先、起源中心、生态优势或完整的侏罗纪—白垩纪分布；地图仅提供年龄语境，模型输出、PBDB 出现记录和可见标记仍是分开的证据层，并非化石与古地图的精确共定位。

title.en: Late Miocene C4 biomass proxy window
title.zh: 晚中新世 C4 生物量代用指标窗口

description.en: Open the rounded 8–6 Ma window for Cerling et al.’s fossil tooth-enamel δ13C records from Asia, Africa, North America and South America, which document a regional, asynchronous rise in C4-plant biomass.
description.zh: 打开取整后的 8–6 Ma 窗口，检查 Cerling 等来自亚洲、非洲、北美和南美的化石牙釉质 δ13C 记录；这些记录显示 C4 植物生物量在各区域异步上升。

limitations: The 7 Ma route is the midpoint of a multi-continent proxy window, not a direct grass specimen or a globally synchronous Poaceae event; the cited evidence is fossil animal enamel, not a census of plants.

Enamel δ13C records an animal-diet and local-habitat signal. It cannot identify which C4 lineages supplied the biomass, prove open grassland cover or establish a global Poaceae FAD/LAD, direct ancestry or complete distribution.

Map markers retain sampled locality and reconstruction limits; proxy regions and any visible occurrences are not exact fossil-to-paleomap co-registration. / 牙釉质 δ13C 记录动物食物与局部生境信号，不能识别贡献生物量的 C4 谱系、证明开阔草地覆盖，也不能建立全球禾本科 FAD/LAD、直系祖先或完整分布；地图标记仍受采样地点和重建限制，并非化石与古地图精确共定位。

title.zh: 大平原 C3–C4 植硅体转变

description.en: Open the rounded 8–5.5 Ma window for fourteen selected palaeosol assemblages from Nebraska and Kansas. Stromberg’s study reports that chloridoid and other potentially C4 PACMAD short-cell phytoliths reached roughly 50–60% of the grass component by about 5.5 Ma.
description.zh: 打开内布拉斯加和堪萨斯 8–5.5 Ma 的窗口，检查 14 组精选古土壤植硅体组合。Stromberg 研究报告，到约 5.5 Ma，虎尾草族及其他可能属于 C4 的 PACMAD 短细胞植硅体约占禾草组分的 50–60%。

limitations: The 6.75 Ma route is a rounded midpoint of a selected central-Great-Plains assemblage envelope (Stromberg 2011, pp. 50–71), not a direct date for every phytolith or a continental/global transition.

The percentage is within the grass component, not total vegetation, and PACMAD-type short cells are not all diagnostic of C4 photosynthesis; the assemblage does not establish a Poaceae crown origin, global FAD/LAD or direct ancestry.

Fourteen Nebraska–Kansas palaeosols are a regional, preservation- and sampling-bounded record. Their map context does not show complete distribution, abundance or exact fossil-to-paleomap co-registration. / 该比例只针对禾草组分而非全部植被，PACMAD 型短细胞并非都能诊断 C4 光合；14 组内布拉斯加—堪萨斯古土壤是受区域、保存和采样限制的记录，不能证明禾本科冠群起源、全球 FAD/LAD、直系祖先、完整分布、丰度或化石与古地图精确共定位。

title.en: Corral Bluffs dated legume fruit window
title.zh: Corral Bluffs 定年豆科果实窗口

description.en: Open the 65.35 Ma Corral Bluffs window for the dated legume fruit and associated leaflets documented by Lyson et al. in Colorado’s Denver Formation, and inspect the oldest unequivocal legume-fossil context discussed with later phylogenomic estimates.
description.zh: 打开 65.35 Ma 的 Corral Bluffs 窗口，检查 Lyson 等在科罗拉多州丹佛组记录的定年豆科果实及相关小叶，并结合后续系统基因组研究讨论的最早明确豆科化石语境。

limitations: The 65.35 Ma value is a dated locality-level occurrence (Lyson et al. 2019, pp. 977–983, Figure 3J–K and supplementary stratigraphy), not an exact crown-Fabaceae origin or global FAD/LAD.

Fruit and leaflets are direct fossil observations; family placement and deeper divergence estimates remain source- and model-dependent, and the material is not a direct ancestor or evidence of a single post-K–Pg recovery pathway.

One Colorado section is a sampled regional record with preservation and collection bias. The map does not establish complete Fabaceae distribution, abundance, ecological causation or exact fossil-to-paleomap co-registration. / 65.35 Ma 是地点级化石出现记录，不是豆科冠群确切起源或全球 FAD/LAD；果实和小叶是直接观察，科级归属及更深分化年龄仍依赖来源与模型，不能视为直系祖先或单一 K–Pg 后恢复路径；单个科罗拉多剖面受保存和采集偏差影响，地图不能证明完整分布、丰度、生态因果或化石与古地图精确共定位。
